info.title: Akeneo PIM REST API

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get an authentication token. No need to be authenticated to use this endpoint.
requests.name: Get authentication token

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get the list of all the available endpoints. No need to be authenticated to use this endpoint.
requests.name: Get list of all endpoints

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get a list of PAM asset categories. PAM asset categories are paginated and sorted by `root/left`.
requests.name: Get list of PAM asset categories
requests.summary: Get list of PAM asset categories

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to update several PAM asset categories at once.
requests.name: Update/create several PAM asset categories

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new PAM asset category.
requests.name: Create a new PAM asset category
requests.summary: Create a new PAM asset category

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get the information about a given PAM asset category.
requests.name: Get a PAM asset category
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to update a given PAM asset category. Know more about Update behavior. Note that if no category exists for the given code, it creates it.
requests.name: Update/create a PAM asset category
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get a list of asset families. Asset families are paginated.
requests.name: Get list of asset families

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get a list of assets of a given asset family. Assets are paginated. This endpoint is case sensitive on the asset family code.
requests.name: Get the list of the assets of a given asset family
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get the list of the assets of a given asset family

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to update and/or create several assets of one given asset family at once. Learn more about the Update behavior. Note that if the asset does not already exist for the given asset family, it creates it. This endpoint is case sensitive on the asset family code.
requests.name: Update/create several assets
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a given asset. This endpoint is case sensitive on the asset family code.
requests.name: Delete an asset
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to get the information about a given asset for a given asset family. This endpoint is case sensitive on the asset family code.
requests.name: Get an asset of a given asset family
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get an asset of a given asset family
